title: A text campaign that breaks three rules at once
question: Can I text everyone who ordered this month with 20% off, tonight at 9:30pm?
expected: Not tonight: quiet hours start at 9pm. The 90-day relationship rule allows the audience without a separate opt-in, and 20% is exactly the cap. Cites the messaging sections it used.

trace.question: Can I text everyone who ordered this month with 20% off, tonight at 9:30pm?
trace.answer:
Not as you've described it. I can't send or schedule texts, so this only covers what the rules allow.

**Timing:** Tonight at 9:30pm is inside the quiet hours, which run from 9pm to 8am Mountain time. No marketing text can go out then. The earliest slot is 8am tomorrow, Mountain time [messaging: Quiet hours].

**Offer:** 20% is the most a message may offer without your approval, so it's allowed. The offer has to expire within 7 days and apply once per customer. It also can't include Seasonal Specials [messaging: Offers in messages].

**Who can get it:** Of the 76 identified customers with completed orders since October 1, only 18 have a phone number on file and haven't unsubscribed. Everyone else is off the list. Customers who ordered in the last 90 days and gave a phone number can get up to two marketing texts a calendar month without a separate opt-in. Anyone who has unsubscribed gets nothing [messaging: Who may receive texts]. None of the 18 has verified SMS consent, but that doesn't matter here because they all ordered within the last 90 days.

**Frequency:** Check that none of the 18 has already had two marketing texts this month [messaging: Frequency]. I can't see message history, so I can't check that for you.

detail.purpose: Count customers who ordered this month by textability
detail.sql: select count(distinct c.id) total, count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.has_phone and c.unsubscribed_at is null) with_phone_not_unsub, count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.has_phone and c.unsubscribed_at is null and c.sms_opt_in) verified from orders o join customers c on c.id=o.customer_id where o.state='completed' and (o.created_at at time zone (select timezone from merchants)) >= '2026-10-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER(WHERE c.has_phone AND c.unsubscribed_at IS NULL) AS with_phone_not_unsub, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FILTER(WHERE c.has_phone AND c.unsubscribed_at IS NULL AND c.sms_opt_in) AS verified FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS o JOIN (SELECT * FROM customers WHERE merchant_id = 2) AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.state = 'completed' AND (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 2) AS merchants)) >= '2026-10-01' LIMIT 500
